title: P3-T1 Autonomous Engineering Extension Backlog
completion_authority: Task state is implementation/evidence scheduling only; P3-T0 closure and independent sign-off remain separate.

tasks.title: Compile deterministic workflow and task graph
tasks.objective: Materialize versioned workflow IR/DSL compilation, semantic task typing, bounded decomposition, critical-path analysis, deterministic scheduling and simulation.
acceptance: Preserve every inherited masterplan requirement, gap, risk and contract exactly until executable evidence closes it.
No task may self-promote implementation maturity, completion checkbox, implementation signature or verification signature.
Every effectful autonomous action must remain policy-bound, bounded, replayable or compensable, and independently verifiable.
Evidence must bind the exact branch/head and executable test or runtime receipt.

masterplan_obligations.title: Workflow Intermediate Representation
requirements: IR includes dependencies, inputs/outputs, authority, retries, timeouts and compensation.
Compiler/runtime share the same versioned IR contract.

masterplan_obligations.title: Workflow DSL
requirements: DSL cannot express undeclared privilege or bypass policy.
Parsing/versioning errors fail with precise diagnostics.

masterplan_obligations.title: Workflow Compiler
requirements: Compilation is deterministic for identical source/version.
Reject missing capabilities, cycles and invalid compensation before runtime.

masterplan_obligations.title: Workflow Versioning
requirements: In-flight operations retain the workflow version they started with unless explicit migration occurs.
Version changes declare compatibility.

masterplan_obligations.title: Workflow Migration
requirements: Migration declares state mapping and irreversible transformations.
Unmigratable runs remain pinned or explicitly terminated/restarted.

masterplan_obligations.title: Semantic Task Types
requirements: Task type drives default policy/budgets/tests but cannot grant privilege.
Unknown tasks use conservative generic classification.

masterplan_obligations.title: Task Complexity Estimator
requirements: Estimator exposes uncertainty and calibration.
Underestimation cannot bypass hard limits; runtime can revise estimate.

masterplan_obligations.title: Task Decomposition Engine
requirements: Subtasks preserve parent constraints/authority.
Detect over-decomposition, cycles and missing integration step.

masterplan_obligations.title: Critical Path Analysis
requirements: Use real dependency/state data rather than narrative estimates alone.
Recompute when task duration/dependency changes.

masterplan_obligations.title: Scheduling Algorithms
requirements: Schedulers respect hard dependencies/leases/authority before optimization.
Algorithm choice is measurable and replaceable.

masterplan_obligations.title: Scheduling Simulator
requirements: Simulation is non-authoritative and labels assumptions.
Compare throughput/latency/fairness/resource metrics across policies.

tasks.title: Bound autonomy control and escalation
tasks.objective: Add explicit autonomy control-state transitions, bounded escalation grants, revocation/de-escalation behavior, and evidence-bound control decisions.
acceptance: Preserve every inherited masterplan requirement, gap, risk and contract exactly until executable evidence closes it.
No task may self-promote implementation maturity, completion checkbox, implementation signature or verification signature.
Every effectful autonomous action must remain policy-bound, bounded, replayable or compensable, and independently verifiable.
Evidence must bind the exact branch/head and executable test or runtime receipt.

masterplan_obligations.title: Control Theory for Autonomy
requirements: Controllers cannot exceed policy/authority or resource bounds.
Stability/oscillation behavior is evaluated before production use.

masterplan_obligations.title: Autonomy Escalation
requirements: Escalation requires explicit eligibility and approval policy.
Escalated grants expire/revoke cleanly.

tasks.title: Build workspace-aware safe-change planner
tasks.objective: Bind project memory, workspace/resource identity, dependency graphs, rebuild impact, change-risk estimates and safe-change gates into deterministic repository work plans.
acceptance: Preserve every inherited masterplan requirement, gap, risk and contract exactly until executable evidence closes it.
No task may self-promote implementation maturity, completion checkbox, implementation signature or verification signature.
Every effectful autonomous action must remain policy-bound, bounded, replayable or compensable, and independently verifiable.
Evidence must bind the exact branch/head and executable test or runtime receipt.

masterplan_obligations.title: Project Memory
requirements: Project memory is isolated by project/tenant and trust class.
Memory updates preserve source and supersession lineage.

masterplan_obligations.title: Workspace Model
requirements: Workspace links reference canonical underlying objects rather than duplicate them.
Membership/permission changes propagate to active operations.

masterplan_obligations.title: Resource Namespace
requirements: Namespace resolution includes tenant/project/version scope.
Reject traversal, confusable or ambiguous resource names.

masterplan_obligations.title: Resource Resolution Service
requirements: Resolution checks authority and lifecycle before returning handles.
Ambiguous/latest aliases are explicit and traceable.

masterplan_obligations.title: Artifact Dependency Graph
requirements: Edges are typed and version-specific.
Cycles are detected/handled according to artifact class.

masterplan_obligations.title: Artifact Rebuild Engine
requirements: Rebuild only from verified inputs/producer versions.
Compare rebuilt digest/semantic output against expectations.

masterplan_obligations.title: Impact Analysis Engine
requirements: Use architecture/trace/dependency ownership graphs.
Expose uncertainty and missing edges instead of asserting complete impact.

masterplan_obligations.title: Change Risk Estimator
requirements: Estimator does not replace hard gates.
Calibrate predicted risk against observed incidents/regressions.

masterplan_obligations.title: Safe Change Planner
requirements: Plan must satisfy ownership/compatibility/risk/budget constraints before mutation.
Prefer reversible staged changes for uncertain/high-impact work.

tasks.title: Compose trusted tools and system changes
tasks.objective: Statically analyze and simulate plans, compose tools from declared capabilities/dependencies, validate tool health/results, and bind generated changes to contracts and extension points.
acceptance: Preserve every inherited masterplan requirement, gap, risk and contract exactly until executable evidence closes it.
No task may self-promote implementation maturity, completion checkbox, implementation signature or verification signature.
Every effectful autonomous action must remain policy-bound, bounded, replayable or compensable, and independently verifiable.
Evidence must bind the exact branch/head and executable test or runtime receipt.

masterplan_obligations.title: System Compiler Concept
requirements: Compiler outputs are derived artifacts, never new authority.
Generation is deterministic and traceable to input contracts.

masterplan_obligations.title: Code Generation from Contracts
requirements: Generated files are clearly marked and reproducible.
Manual extension points avoid edits being overwritten.

masterplan_obligations.title: Plan Static Analyzer
requirements: Analysis is deterministic over versioned plan IR.
Findings have location/severity/remediation.

masterplan_obligations.title: Plan Simulation
requirements: Simulation receipts are marked non-production evidence.
Include failure/timeout/resource scenarios, not only happy path.

masterplan_obligations.title: Tool Composition Engine
requirements: Composition cannot aggregate permissions into broader authority.
Data transformations between tools are schema/trust checked.

masterplan_obligations.title: Tool Dependency Graph
requirements: Dependencies are versioned and typed.
Planner can detect unavailable/conflicting tool chains before execution.

masterplan_obligations.title: Tool Health
requirements: Health distinguishes transport success from semantic correctness.
Stale health cannot authorize risky operations.

masterplan_obligations.title: Tool Capability Discovery
requirements: Discovery data is untrusted until validated/signed according to source.
Discovered capability never implies granted authority.

masterplan_obligations.title: Tool Result Trust
requirements: Tool output is data, not instructions or authority.
High-impact results require independent validation where appropriate.

masterplan_obligations.title: Side-Effect Ledger
requirements: Ledger entries are durable before/after effects according to operation class.
Unknown outcomes remain unresolved until reconciliation.

masterplan_obligations.title: Compensation Engine
requirements: Compensation semantics are explicit and not assumed equivalent to rollback.
Failed compensation becomes durable incident/reconciliation work.

masterplan_obligations.title: Saga Workflows
requirements: Saga state is durable and resumable across process failure.
Each step has idempotency, timeout and compensation/reconciliation policy.
